MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Aquaculture.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Morphology and Anatomy? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Morphology and Anatomy.

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Production Systems.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Production Systems.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Production Systems.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Production Systems.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
